question: Identify an element that does NOT belong to the third period.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bromine.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bromine** (Br) is a **halogen **and is located in the** fourth period**.
 
• The third period includes elements from** sodium (Na)** to** argon (Ar)**.
 
• **Silicon **(Si) and **phosphorus** (P) are both located in the third period.
 
• **Argon** (Ar) is a **noble gas **and is located in the third period.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Potassium (K), Calcium (Ca), Scandium (Sc), Titanium (Ti), Vanadium (V), Chromium (Cr), Manganese (Mn), Iron (Fe), Cobalt (Co), Nickel (Ni), Copper (Cu), Zinc (Zn), Gallium (Ga), Germanium (Ge), Arsenic (As), Selenium (Se), Bromine (Br), and Krypton (Kr) are the **elements** associated with Period 4.
 
• There are a total of** eighteen elements** in the fourth period of the current periodic table.
 
• **Ten** d block elements, **six** p block elements, and** two** s block elements are among them.
